findings.claim: The plan does not specify any negative-control run showing each new or changed check failing on a deliberately broken input before passing.
findings.evidence: Step 2 modifies the existing success case and adds email validation cases in tests/run.sh, and Step 3 adds syntax checks using node --check and bash -n, while Step 4 only runs npm test and npm run lint and confirms both exit successfully without first demonstrating failure on broken input or syntax.
findings.repair: Add an explicit negative-control step for each new or changed check so that deliberately broken inputs (and broken syntax for any syntax check) are observed failing before the passing verification run.

findings.claim: The plan does not state what is in and out of scope, and Step 3 adds test and lint scripts to package.json despite the repository defining only check and no linter configuration.
findings.evidence: The four-step plan contains no in-scope or out-of-scope boundary statement, and Step 3 acknowledges that the repository currently defines only check and includes no linter configuration before proposing new test and lint scripts in package.json.
findings.repair: State explicitly what is in and out of scope for the task, and remove the unrequested package.json test and lint script additions unless explicitly within the stated scope.

findings.claim: The verification commands named in Step 4 (npm test and npm run lint) do not exist in this repository as written.
findings.evidence: In SOURCE_CONTEXT package.json, scripts defines only check ('node scripts/check.js') and defines neither test nor lint, yet Step 4 specifies running npm test and npm run lint instead of npm run check.
findings.repair: Update Step 4 to run the repository's existing verification command npm run check (or node scripts/check.js) rather than nonexistent npm test and npm run lint commands.

findings.claim: Step 2 proposes editing tests/run.sh, but tests/run.sh is not present in the supplied repository context to confirm its existence.
findings.evidence: SOURCE_CONTEXT includes only package.json, scripts/check.js, and src/validate.js; although scripts/check.js invokes 'bash tests/run.sh', tests/run.sh itself is absent from SOURCE_CONTEXT and Step 2 does not state it will be created.
findings.repair: Confirm tests/run.sh exists in the repository tree before editing it, or state in the plan that it will be created if missing.
